items.title: Audric Estime: Makes splash in New Orleans debut
items.text:
Estime carried the ball 15 times for 72 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 23-22 overtime win over the Browns. he also caught his only target for five yards.

items.title: Drew Lock: Injures oblique during Week 9 win
items.text:
Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said after Sunday's 17-3 win over the Cardinals that Lock sustained an oblique injury during the game, leaving Lock's availability for Week 10 against the Raiders up in the air, Bob Condotta of the Seattle Times reports.

items.title: Tyler Shough: Does just enough in OT win
items.text:

items.title: Daniel Jones: Staying with Indy
items.text:
Jones will remain with the Colts through Tuesday's trade deadline after the team informed him Saturday that he won't be moved, Tom Pelissero of The Ringer reports.
